scripts.infra:up: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres nats
scripts.infra:down: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml stop postgres nats
scripts.infra:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml logs -f --tail=100 postgres nats
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres nats && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec -T postgres psql -q -U nebula -d postgres -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS nebula WITH (FORCE)" -c "CREATE DATABASE nebula" && pnpm db:migrate
scripts.db:psql: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec postgres psql -U nebula -d nebula
scripts.docker:push: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml build nebulahome && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml push nebulahome
scripts.docker:shell: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec nebulahome sh
scripts.docker:psql: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec nebulahome psql -U nebula -d nebula
scripts.docker:db:reset: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml exec nebulahome nebula-reset-db
scripts.docker:wipe: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml rm -s -f nebulahome && docker volume rm nebulahome_nebula-data nebulahome_nebula-postgres nebulahome_nebula-nats
